readiness.note_en: Go-Live readiness is a planning baseline across product truth, design, implementation and remaining runtime gates. Program completion and Core scope readiness are read from the evidence-backed S00-S19 program source; design readiness is read from bcsentinel-design-readiness.json.
readiness.note_de: Die Go-Live-Readiness ist eine Planungsbaseline über Product Truth, Design, Umsetzung und verbleibende Runtime-Gates. Programmfortschritt und Core-Scope-Readiness werden aus der evidenzbasierten S00-S19-Programmquelle gelesen; Design-Readiness stammt aus bcsentinel-design-readiness.json.

principles: Web-Dashboard = lesen, verstehen, analysieren, vergleichen und berichten
Product System = normative Produkt- und UX-Source-of-Truth
Keine wichtigen KPIs mehrfach manuell pflegen

sprints.objective_en: Freeze the integrated product definition and cross-repository authority rules.
sprints.objective_de: Integrierte Produktdefinition und Cross-Repo-Authority verbindlich einfrieren.

sprints.objective_en: Define the real remediation entity so the current Actions UX has a truthful data model.
sprints.objective_de: Eine echte Remediation-Entität definieren, damit das Actions-UX auf einem realen Datenmodell basiert.

sprints.objective_en: Make Business Central the single authority for tenant-wide BCSentinel notifications.
sprints.objective_de: Business Central zur einzigen Authority für tenantweite BCSentinel-Benachrichtigungen machen.

sprints.objective_en: Consolidate Free Entry, Assessment, Validation and Monitoring into one pricing and access truth.
sprints.objective_de: Free Entry, Assessment, Validation und Monitoring in einer Pricing- und Access-Wahrheit konsolidieren.

sprints.objective_en: Add the approved BCSentinel orange as a normative design token.
sprints.objective_de: Das freigegebene BCSentinel-Orange als normativen Design-Token ergänzen.

sprints.objective_en: Separate Estimated Loss, Potential Saving, Validated Improvement and Realized Saving rigorously.
sprints.objective_de: Estimated Loss, Potential Saving, Validated Improvement und Realized Saving verbindlich trennen.

sprints.objective_en: Create one final Free, Assessment and Monitoring Overview without web-side BC actions.
sprints.objective_de: Je ein finales Free-, Assessment- und Monitoring-Overview ohne BC-Steuerung im Web festlegen.

sprints.objective_en: Bring every existing core page to at least 98% design readiness and product truth.
sprints.objective_de: Alle bestehenden Kernseiten auf mindestens 98% Design-Readiness und Product Truth bringen.

sprints.objective_en: Bind Actions UX to the remediation contract and keep dashboard actions read-only.
sprints.objective_de: Actions-UX an den Remediation-Contract binden und Dashboard-Aktionen read-only halten.

sprints.objective_en: Reduce Settings to web-owned account data and read-only BC configuration summaries.
sprints.objective_de: Settings auf Web-Kontodaten und read-only BC-Konfigurationsübersichten reduzieren.

sprints.objective_en: Apply the financial outcome contract consistently to analytics, monitoring and reports.
sprints.objective_de: Den Financial-Outcome-Contract konsistent auf Analytics, Monitoring und Reports anwenden.

sprints.objective_en: Align external claims, pricing and pilot scope with verified product truth.
sprints.objective_de: Externe Claims, Pricing und Pilot-Scope mit verifizierter Product Truth abgleichen.

sprints.objective_en: Freeze BCSentinel UI System 1.0 in Figma and Product System.
sprints.objective_de: BCSentinel UI System 1.0 in Figma und Product System einfrieren.

sprints.objective_en: Complete invite, registration, verification, password reset and access states.
sprints.objective_de: Invite, Registrierung, Verifikation, Passwort-Reset und Access-States vollständig designen.

sprints.objective_en: Complete Impressum, privacy, terms, DPA and cookie surfaces where required.
sprints.objective_de: Impressum, Datenschutz, Terms, AVV/DPA und falls nötig Cookie-Flächen abschließen.

sprints.objective_en: Specify checkout, payment, activation, cancellation and invoice states.
sprints.objective_de: Checkout-, Payment-, Aktivierungs-, Kündigungs- und Rechnungszustände spezifizieren.

sprints.objective_en: Complete 403/404/500, maintenance, loading, empty and partial-data states.
sprints.objective_de: 403/404/500, Maintenance, Loading, Empty und Partial-Data States abschließen.

sprints.objective_en: Accept all final screens on desktop, tablet and mobile without new design decisions.
sprints.objective_de: Alle finalen Screens auf Desktop, Tablet und Mobile ohne neue Designentscheidungen abnehmen.

sprints.objective_en: Implement the remediation action model, pages, permissions, audit and validation links in AL.
sprints.objective_de: Remediation Action Model, Pages, Permissions, Audit und Validation-Verknüpfungen in AL umsetzen.

sprints.objective_en: Implement notification setup, recipients, events, templates, delivery and tests in BC.
sprints.objective_de: Notification Setup, Empfänger, Events, Templates, Zustellung und Tests in BC umsetzen.

sprints.objective_en: Expose read-only action list, detail, history and metrics APIs for the dashboard.
sprints.objective_de: Read-only APIs für Action-Liste, Detail, Historie und Metriken bereitstellen.

sprints.objective_en: Expose a read-only notification configuration summary for Settings.
sprints.objective_de: Eine read-only Notification-Konfigurationsübersicht für Settings bereitstellen.

sprints.objective_en: Migrate legacy product codes and pricing without changing existing customer rights silently.
sprints.objective_de: Legacy-Produktcodes und Pricing migrieren, ohne bestehende Kundenrechte still zu verändern.

sprints.objective_en: Implement app shell, auth, tenant, entitlement contexts, API client, gates and tokens.
sprints.objective_de: AppShell, Auth-, Tenant-, Entitlement-Kontexte, API-Client, Gates und Tokens umsetzen.

sprints.objective_en: Implement Overview, Findings, Financial Impact, Actions, Reports, Scans and Monitoring against real APIs.
sprints.objective_de: Overview, Findings, Financial Impact, Actions, Reports, Scans und Monitoring gegen echte APIs umsetzen.

sprints.objective_en: Implement Settings, Billing, Support, Auth, locked and global states.
sprints.objective_de: Settings, Billing, Support, Auth, Locked und globale States umsetzen.

sprints.objective_en: Connect real pricing, forms, legal links, SEO and accessibility to production surfaces.
sprints.objective_de: Echtes Pricing, Forms, Legal Links, SEO und Accessibility an die Produktionsflächen anbinden.

sprints.objective_en: Use one backend data contract for web, HTML, PDF and Monitoring reports.
sprints.objective_de: Einen Backend-Datenvertrag für Web-, HTML-, PDF- und Monitoring-Reports verwenden.

sprints.objective_en: Verify auth, tenant, membership, role, entitlement and resource isolation end to end.
sprints.objective_de: Auth, Tenant, Membership, Role, Entitlement und Resource Isolation End-to-End prüfen.

sprints.objective_en: Run backend, AL, API, report, pricing, dashboard, accessibility and responsive automated gates.
sprints.objective_de: Backend-, AL-, API-, Report-, Pricing-, Dashboard-, Accessibility- und Responsive-Gates automatisiert ausführen.

sprints.objective_en: Complete real Viewer, Scan, Setup, Scheduler/Admin, actions and notifications runtime evidence.
sprints.objective_de: Reale Runtime-Evidence für Viewer, Scan, Setup, Scheduler/Admin, Actions und Notifications abschließen.

sprints.objective_en: Validate real Stripe checkout, portal, invoices, SMTP, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and failure paths.
sprints.objective_de: Stripe Checkout, Portal, Rechnungen, SMTP, SPF, DKIM, DMARC und Fehlerpfade real validieren.

sprints.objective_en: Prove backup, restore, RPO/RTO, migration rollback/forward and deployment recovery.
sprints.objective_de: Backup, Restore, RPO/RTO, Migration Rollback/Forward und Deployment Recovery nachweisen.

sprints.objective_en: Run a real landing-to-monitoring pilot customer journey.
sprints.objective_de: Einen realen Pilotkunden-Journey von Landingpage bis Monitoring durchführen.

sprints.objective_en: Validate staged 1→5→10→25→50 tenant operation including a 24h+ soak.
sprints.objective_de: Gestuften 1→5→10→25→50-Tenant-Betrieb inklusive 24h+-Soak validieren.

sprints.objective_en: Freeze immutable product, design and runtime release evidence; only P0 fixes remain.
sprints.objective_de: Unveränderliche Product-, Design- und Runtime-Release-Evidence einfrieren; danach nur noch P0-Fixes.

sprints.objective_en: Launch one tenant first, then expand to 2–5 pilot customers under observation.
sprints.objective_de: Zuerst einen Tenant live nehmen und anschließend kontrolliert auf 2–5 Pilotkunden erweitern.
